stages.name: seed_stability
stages.hypothesis: representation structure and activity directions repeat across five seeds even when neuron IDs differ.
stages.experiment: pairwise sample distance geometry and direction-score correlations on identical test samples
stages.mismatch: low direction score similarity would weaken the common-direction claim.
stages.revised_hypothesis: common geometry may be more stable than any named neuron or direction coordinate.

stages.name: activity_directions
stages.hypothesis: each dynamic activity has a distinct distributed direction.
stages.experiment: one-vs-rest hidden-layer-2 centroid contrast for each activity
stages.mismatch: direction concentration or seed-specific feature sets can contradict a single shared explanation.
stages.revised_hypothesis: activity directions may be geometrically repeatable but feature implementations may vary.

stages.name: feature_combinations
stages.hypothesis: feature combinations explain direction scores better than single features.
stages.experiment: controlled feature selection and pair joint R2 gain
stages.mismatch: small joint gains mean the direction is mostly a single-feature or correlated proxy.
stages.revised_hypothesis: some activity directions require a group, but the group may be redundant.

stages.name: correlation_control
stages.hypothesis: the same feature groups remain after correlated duplicates are removed.
stages.mismatch: different representatives from the same correlated family are not independent evidence.
stages.revised_hypothesis: feature families, rather than exact feature names, are the stable explanatory units.

stages.name: feature_intervention
stages.hypothesis: joint feature perturbation selectively damages the matching activity more than a single or random feature.
stages.experiment: test dynamic subset: controlled combination vs first feature vs random combination
stages.mismatch: negative or seed-dependent changes weaken causal interpretation.
stages.revised_hypothesis: feature combinations are necessary under this model, but not necessarily uniquely causal.

stages.name: activation_direction_intervention
stages.hypothesis: removing one activity direction selectively reduces that activity recall more than removing a random direction.
stages.experiment: full and half projection removal from hidden layer 2 on dynamic test subset
stages.mismatch: broad accuracy loss without selective target recall loss means the direction is not activity-specific.
stages.revised_hypothesis: directions are useful decision coordinates but may be entangled with neighboring activity boundaries.

stages.name: human_structure
stages.hypothesis: temporal feature family combination→distributed direction score→activity judgment is a readable approximation.
stages.experiment: report controlled feature representatives, joint R2, projection intervention, and target recall per activity

result.structure: feature family representatives -> one-vs-rest direction score -> six-class output
result.caveat: not a causal symbolic rule and not guaranteed unique across seeds

stages.mismatch: seed variation and correlated feature families prevent a unique final formula.
stages.revised_hypothesis: the stable object is a family-level computational motif, not a single formula.
